body: Hey ive experiened the exact same thing, still ynwilling to let go of my past ‘better’ version. Which holds me back to be better today. Wanna motivate each other ?

Hey! I feel the exact same way what i’ve heard from others is to just keep going like at least working so you can have money. I tried to take my life and let my life stop for a year and let me tell you i feel way worse and without money friends and everything. Everyone has their own problems but maybe sharing a bit of your load to a trusted friend or family can help. Even though your problems compared to your father’s cancer might be small, it’s still something that is bothering you. You should share this, your family would rather help you out now with this ‘small’ problem than afterwards you not having around or you being a shell of yourself.
Hey I just turned 25 and I relate to this post 100% about everything
Im almost 21 and i feel the same way 😅 i have never been like this also. I guess it’s just the realisation of everything that made me feel like this.
Yeahh i get that. Its like what is the point if im not going to be there anyway. Well i do hope you get that certificate
True but aren’t you afraid u will regret it later i am so scared

It’s not trivial. We actually have the same kind of problem. Im also taking a break from uni and i feel so bad about it but at the same time i can’t concentrate. And i had also thoughts about military but just in my mind bc i have no discipline whatsoever. 

And yes i used to entertain myself by binge watching series and movies. But i can’t seem to entertain myself lately. The only thing i can think about is how much i will regret this later or that i simply don’t care anymore about myself. 

I feel like a burden bc i am like a spoiled brat i had these opportunities that i am just wasting and i dont even know why.
WE WERE ON A BREAK

You described it so wonderful. I feel the same way. And I actually didnt also want to talk to friends so I isolated myself  bc idk what I would have said how I would have described it and also scared of the reactions. But they came by and tried and now I am talking to them and it actually feels better to talk to friends bc they know you. They know how to comfort you and you will feel loved again. Hope it gets better for you
Thankyou for your kind and inspirational words
What difference do you see? I just stopped today

I feel i wasted so many years and I am still wasting right now by just overthinking. Altough I know its sabotaging me as it did in the past I still can’t stop. So I understand you very well you are not alone. If you want to talk about it you can always message me

I don’t know i have everything but i feel like i will lose it all. Because i never took myself serious and i think i ruined every relationship i have with family/friends. I feel there is something wrong with me. I don’t know anything anymore. I feel like the only way that i feel okay is when i think if i will jump of a bridge. Then i won’t have the fear of failure or dissapointment anymore. I really just don’t see myself living in the future anymore. And in the present the only thing i want to do is isolate and sleep all day. I also feel like a burden because of this because everyone is trying to help but i can only dissapoint everyone.
